⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. TRL Pipeline Digital Twin

End-to-end digital twin of Dstl's TRL 1-6 pipeline. Automated maturity assessment against TRL criteria. Portfolio-level resource allocation optimisation. Research programme risk scoring with Monte Carlo. Milestone tracking with automated escalation. Target: 100% TRL pipeline visibility by 2028. Eliminate manual portfolio reporting lag.

2. AI Assurance Framework for Defence

Defence-specific AI assurance aligned with JSP 936. Automated assurance case generation. Adversarial robustness testing for all defence AI. Bias detection for personnel-facing systems. Explainability matrix by operational risk tier. Target: All AI deployments JSP 936-assured by 2027. Zero unassured AI in operational use.

3. CBRN Sensor Fusion Platform

Multi-spectral CBRN sensor fusion across all modalities. Real-time agent identification with confidence scoring. Plume dispersion integrated into battle management. Bio-aerosol classification from distributed sampling. Radiation anomaly detection with alerting. Target: Sub-60-second detection-to-alert cycle. NATO STANAG 2461 integration.

4. Cyber Range Automation

Automated cyber range scenario generation. Realistic threat emulation of state-level TTPs. Network simulation for weapons and C4ISR. Automated red/blue team orchestration. Skills gap analysis per cyber role. Target: Weekly automated cyber range exercises. 50% reduction in setup time.

5. Human-Machine Teaming Metrics

Standardised HMT measurement across domains. Cognitive workload in system design. Trust calibration for autonomous operators. Team analytics for human-autonomy configs. Training effectiveness with adaptive pathways. Target: HMT metrics in all autonomous evaluations. Evidence-based operator selection by 2028.

6. Autonomous Systems Safety Gate

Automated safety gate compliance at each TRL. Safety case evidence collection and verification. Adversarial testing for autonomous robustness. Human oversight validation per autonomy level. Regulatory compliance against UK and NATO. Target: Zero deployment without safety gate clearance. Automated safety case for TRL 4-6.

7. Research Data Sovereignty

Sovereign data infrastructure for classified datasets. Automated classification enforcement. Five Eyes sharing protocol compliance. Retention scheduling per MOD disposal policy. Cross-programme discovery via metadata. Target: 100% classification compliance. Zero sovereignty breaches in sharing.

8. Parliamentary Evidence Automation

Automated evidence for Defence Select Committee. Value for money dashboards for Dstl. Ministerial briefing from programme data. PQ response with audit-grade citations. International S&T spend benchmarking. Target: 75% reduction in evidence prep time. Real-time Parliamentary reporting by 2028.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No autonomous system deployed without human-in-the-loop safety assurance at every TRL gate — Def Stan 00-056 compliance mandatory with zero exceptions
  • ❌ No CBRN detection algorithm deployed without false-positive/negative validation against live agent data — fielding without live-agent validation risks operational failure
  • ❌ No cyber research capability exported without DIT/ECCN classification and Ministerial approval — uncontrolled export of offensive cyber tools violates export control law
  • ❌ No AI decision support system fielded without adversarial robustness testing against spoofing — adversarial ML vulnerabilities in C2 create unacceptable operational risk
  • ❌ No research data classified above OFFICIAL handled without accredited MOD network gateway — data sovereignty breach on SECRET/TOP SECRET undermines national security
  • ❌ No human performance AI used for selection/screening without ethics board approval and equalities impact assessment — automated personnel decisions require independent oversight

4
